subject.title: Publish macOS beta desktop assets and appcast for v2026.5.22-beta.1

question: Should beta OpenClaw releases be required to publish signed macOS desktop assets and `appcast-beta.xml` before npm/plugin beta publication, or is beta macOS desktop distribution optional for this train?
rationale: Current docs allow beta macOS omission, while this issue requests a stricter signed desktop distribution contract that depends on maintainer-held release credentials and a blocked paired PR.

options.title: Require signed beta desktop distribution
options.body: Land or split the paired signed-beta distribution work and run the private macOS publish workflow before considering this release tracker complete.

options.title: Keep beta desktop optional
options.body: Document that this beta train intentionally has no macOS desktop assets and close or replace the paired gate PR accordingly.

options.title: Narrow to release-note transparency
options.body: Keep npm beta publication independent but require explicit release notes when a beta has no macOS app build.

recommendation.title: Require signed beta desktop distribution
recommendation.body: Land or split the paired signed-beta distribution work and run the private macOS publish workflow before considering this release tracker complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal is recent work on release workflow controls and beta verification, which is the decision surface for this issue.
